content: {"praised":["Smart, talented barrister leads to intriguing, darkly humorous cases.","Roxburgh's performance is legendary, delivering sharp, witty humor.","Show blends drama and comedy with clever, unexpected twists.","Characters are complex, with moral ambiguity adding depth.","Humor is dark yet genuinely funny, keeping viewers engaged."],"criticized":["Storyline fails to be funny, especially cannibalism scenes.","Character portrayed as low class, crude, lacking depth.","Show is trashy, not worth watching after first episode.","Tone feels amoral and seedy, off-putting.","Pacing unclear, some episodes feel slow."]}
